title: High-Impact Growth (Dimagi) — Eric on profit as human flourishing, financial gravity, and 'You're not stuck in traffic — you are traffic'
summary: Jonathan Jackson co-founded Dimagi and is its chief executive; Amie Vaccaro leads growth and strategy for CommCare. They hosted Eric on their High-Impact Growth podcast, where the worked examples are Costco and Novo Nordisk and the takeaway is a question any job candidate can put to an employer.
blockquote: Eric dismantles the conventional definition of profit and offers a radical replacement — profit as the maximization of human flourishing — then explains "financial gravity," the unconscious pull that bends organizations toward the values of whoever holds the money, whether investors or donors.
attribution_title: Co-founder & CEO, Dimagi; VP Growth & Strategy, CommCare — hosts of the High-Impact Growth podcast
